Keyboard shortcuts

/Focus search
↓ ↑ or j kMove through results
EnterOpen the selected topic (docs site if it has one, else GitHub)
gOpen the selected topic on GitHub
dOpen the selected page on the docs site
cCopy a link to the selected topic
1–6Filter: All, Docs, Source, Tests, Samples, Project
fSwitch between Topics and Files views
tToggle light / dark theme
EscClear search / close panels
